Title: 10 Cosy Bedroom Ideas to Make a Small Room Warm
Description: Cosy bedroom ideas for a small room: two warm lamps instead of a ceiling light, layered bedding and a knitted throw, lined curtains that stay clear of the radiator, a big rug and a little reading corner. Includes a measured plan for a small double bedroom.

Title: Cosy Small Bedroom Ideas: Warm Light and Texture
